title: Conditional proxy forker with credit-aware sampling and tenant quarantine
creator: Asha Patel
description:
Problem: we need a non-invasive request duplication flow that lets us run candidate models and analysis pipelines on live traffic while guaranteeing tenant-level cost isolation, predictable budgets, and zero risk to the fast path. Current experiments require ad-hoc sidecars or broad sampling that either increases cost or can affect latency.

Goal: implement a conditional 'proxy forker' at the gateway level that duplicates requests only when per-tenant credits and policy checks pass. The forker must be probabilistic (configurable sampling), deterministic per-request when requested, enforce per-tenant token budgets, support soft-quarantine for tenants causing anomalies, and never block the primary response.

Approach summary: implement a gateway plugin that performs a lightweight policy decision before duplication: 1) check tenant credit ledger (in-memory cache backed by Redis), 2) run a fast anomaly filter (rate / entropy checks), 3) apply deterministic sampler (hash-based) and credit debit, 4) asynchronously forward a copy to the candidate pipeline with per-tenant metadata. Include circuit-breakers and cost meters; expose metrics and per-tenant tracing to Console. Feature-flag the whole flow for progressive rollout.
acceptance_criteria: Primary request latency increase <= 2ms p50 and <= 5ms p95 under normal load
Per-tenant duplication cannot exceed configured monthly token budget; attempts beyond budget are rejected by the forker and logged
Deterministic sampling path produces identical request hashes for repeatable replay tests
Soft-quarantine triggers when duplicate error rate > 5% for a tenant over 15m; quarantined tenant duplication rate drops to 0% automatically
Full observability: metrics for duplicated_count, credit_balance, duplication_rejects, quarantine_events appear in Console per-tenant
End-to-end integration test that injects 10k requests and validates budget enforcement and no primary-path failures
Feature toggle can be applied per-tenant and globally without code deploy
comments: 2025-03-01 -- Asha Patel: Created ticket after runbook session. PM requested strict budget enforcement and fail-closed semantics.

2025-03-03 -- Luca Romero: Initial spike completed. Prototype uses a Redis-backed credit ledger plus a local LRU cache to avoid extra RPCs on hot tenants. Deterministic sampling implemented via siphash(request_id + tenant_id).
2025-03-05 -- Maya Singh (PM): Please ensure soft-quarantine emits an alert and rolls back duplication for the affected tenant. We want an audit trail for compliance review.

2025-03-07 -- Luca Romero: Added per-tenant circuit-breaker. If duplication failures exceed threshold, the forker will stop duplicating for that tenant and create an incident log entry. Implementation note: non-blocking async send with bounded send-queue; overflow increments 'duplication_rejects'.

2025-03-09 -- Chen Wu (Reviewer): Code review comments: need tighter timeouts for async forwards, add backpressure metric on send-queue, and make credit debit atomic with optimistic retry. Also add e2e test for quota exhaustion.
2025-03-11 -- Diego Alvarez (Infra): Blocking: need Redis read-replica support for regional failover. Raised infra ticket INF-88 to provision replica and update client config.
2025-03-12 -- Luca Romero: Implemented reviewer suggestions; pushed PRs. Running integration tests in staging now. Observability hooks added to Console for duplication_rejects and credit_balance.
2025-03-12 -- Maya Singh (PM): Verified basic staging metrics. Follow-up: add a CSV export of per-tenant duplication history for audits.
notes:
Deployment plan: 1) behind global feature flag off by default, 2) enable for internal tenants only, 3) run 48h validation, 4) enable deterministic sampling mode for replay tests, 5) enable rollout to customer tenants with conservative budgets (1% of traffic or 10k tokens/day), 6) monitor metrics and gradually increase. Rollback plan: flip feature flag off; for severe incidents, disable gateway plugin and fail-safe to no-op duplication.

Operational runbook snippets: how to inspect credit ledger, how to remove a tenant from quarantine, how to run a local replay using deterministic hashes.

Cost model: duplication cost charged to tenant's experimental credits; infra will emit charge events consumed by billing pipeline.
